vamo-setup.title: Get started
vamo-setup.summary: Everything about connecting: guided setup in the AI tool you already use (the MCP server with sign-in by default), setup codes, direct API access for your own code, and finding out why Vamo stopped working. Ends with a first search as a short tutorial.

vamo-search.title: Search
vamo-search.summary: Find engineers by what they built, from a technology, a company, a repository, a place, one person or a whole job description. Includes turning intake notes into a search spec, covering a broad topic without missing the famous items, and query phrasings for 50 domains.

vamo-enrich.title: Enrich
vamo-enrich.summary: Learn more about people you already have, by GitHub username or LinkedIn profile: a strength read before an interview, location and LinkedIn for a list, contact details, a personalized opening line, a full research report.

vamo-workflows.title: Workflows
vamo-workflows.summary: Make it repeatable: your own sourcing agent, a search that runs every week, enrichment in front of a message, hand-offs to a tracking system or a spreadsheet.
